annotations.title: Write a brief from a video she likes

description: From a studied video's structure (hook type, beats with their share of the length, CTA, length, shot kinds) writes a brief in her topic and voice and a shot list she can film (shot, seconds, what to say). topic defaults to her first niche topic. The words are written around her topic, never copied: code checks that no run of 7 words from the video's transcript appears in the output. Returns {state:"studying"} while the study runs. The brief is plain text under 4000 characters, ready for edit_job_open's brief.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

topic.description: What the video is about; default her first topic

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: reference_to_brief
title: Write a brief from a video she likes
